candidates.count: 31 single-member candidates, 93 head fits before combinations

step_A: per encoder, the layer with the lowest val ensemble EER of its single-member head (voice route for voice candidates, music route for music candidates); ties -> lower layer. This is an approximation, not a search of each encoder's best ensemble contribution.
step_B_voice: greedy forward selection from the S7 voice fusion (existing weights fixed): each step tries every remaining encoder's step-A layer at w in {0.25, 0.5, 1}; accept the best only if val RT ADS >= current + 0.002; at most 2 additions; ties -> smaller w, then order hubert, d2v, usat, mixwavlm
step_B_music: gpu_control vs gpu_control+mixsslam{a} vs gpu_control+encodec vs gpu_control+mixsslam{a}+encodec (a = step-A block); accept the best only if val RT ADS >= gpu_control + 0.002 (voice = S7); ties -> fewer encoders
joint: voice choice + music choice evaluated together on val RT ADS; must be >= S7_cpu val + 0.002, else the single better passing component change; nothing passing -> no S8
package_feasibility_before_held_out: deflated zip <= 1e10 B with the new weights (measured, not estimated) and L4 estimate <= 45 min; otherwise drop the lowest-val-gain addition before looking at the held-out

step_C_ship.bootstrap: paired group bootstrap (test group_id, 1000 reps, rng 0): P(dADS > 0) >= 0.90
